title: Listening Drill — First aid practice session — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: First aid practice session — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on first aid practice session last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with loose wraps. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: torn bandage.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of wrap angle so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow practice bandage instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the session trainer before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Tuesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
